label: Air emissions accounts totals bridging to emission inventory totals

label.GHG: Greenhouse gases (CO2, N2O in CO2 equivalent, CH4 in CO2 equivalent, HFC in CO2 equivalent, PFC in CO2 equivalent, SF6 in CO2 equivalent, NF3 in CO2 equivalent)

label.AEMIS_RES: Air emissions by resident units (production activities and households)
label.AEMIS_RES_ABR: Air emissions by resident units released from use of fuel purchased abroad - total
label.AEMIS_RES_ABR_FWTR: Air emissions by resident units released from use of fuel purchased abroad  - fishing vessels
label.AEMIS_RES_ABR_LTR: Air emissions by resident units released from use of fuel purchased abroad  - land transport
label.AEMIS_RES_ABR_WTR: Air emissions by resident units released from use of fuel purchased abroad  - water transport
label.AEMIS_RES_ABR_ATR: Air emissions by resident units released from use of fuel purchased abroad  - air transport
label.AEMIS_TER_NRES: Air emissions by non-resident units released from use of fuel purchased on the territory (only if included in national totals according to international conventions) - total
label.AEMIS_TER_NRES_LTR: Air emissions by non-resident units released from use of fuel purchased on the territory (only if included in national totals according to international conventions) - land transport
label.AEMIS_TER_NRES_WTR: Air emissions by non-resident units released from use of fuel purchased on the territory (only if included in national totals according to international conventions) - water transport
label.AEMIS_TER_NRES_ATR: Air emissions by non-resident units released from use of fuel purchased on the territory (only if included in national totals according to international conventions) - air transport
label.AEMIS_TER: Air emissions as reported to international conventions (UNFCCC and CLRTAP inventories, territory principle)
label.AEMIS_TER_LULUCF: Air emissions as reported to international convention including LULUCF (UNFCCC, territory principle)
label.LULUCF: Land use, land use change, and forestry (LULUCF)
label.LULUCF_OTH: Other land use, land use change, and forestry (LULUCF)

label.i: value imputed by Eurostat or other receiving agencies
